title: Define versioned law section and source schemas
note: Native proposal validation, accepted merge and task completion remain separate required gates. This receipt does not mark the backlog complete.
known_limitations: This receipt is not a native completion or merge receipt.
schema.ts and schema.test.ts are uncommitted working-tree files. site_revision is HEAD before those edits.
artifacts/ is gitignored, so this receipt is on disk and is not part of git status.

Official identifiers are copied only from the source. A missing source id, publisher id, section id, instrument id, or pinned revision is quarantined. The qk1_ ingestion key identifies that quarantine record and is rejected if it is presented as an official citation.

When the source text is present and no text version id was supplied, the schema derives tv1:{sourceRevision}:{bodySha256}, marks textVersionId inferred, and does not store that value as an official citation. Unknown text with no supplied version id is quarantined.
A blank language or status is stored as unknown. An explicit status outside current, historical, repealed, superseded, and unknown is quarantined rather than coerced.
Jurisdiction and country strings are territorial labels, not issuer ids. Section license, language, and scope are not inherited from the parent instrument or the source envelope.
Content CIDs are stored only when the row supplies one. This schema does not compute CIDs. Article-title inheritance and Python fixture parity belong to WWL-014.

A revision is accepted when it is 40 or 64 hex characters, or a 12 to 128 character stable token. Floating labels such as main, HEAD, latest, and refs/* are rejected. The schema does not ask a host whether the revision exists.
Repeal-before-enactment is the only chronology check, and it uses the coarser shared precision. Equal values at that precision are admitted.
